leftEvidence.title: The shepherd is struck and sheep scatter within a refining oracle

points.label: Quotation
points.left: The oracle summons the sword against the shepherd.
points.right: Jesus says “I will strike the shepherd” and applies scattering to the disciples.

points.label: Beyond the quote
points.left: The oracle continues through remnant and refining.
points.right: Matthew continues through resurrection, Galilee, and Peter’s denial.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving witness, setting, sequence, speaker, genre, and stated inference boundary.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus quotes the striking and scattering after the meal and promises Galilee

payload.tension: Matthew selects a line from a larger oracle and places it at the supper’s departure boundary.
payload.title: The struck shepherd and the departing disciples
